subject: Civil Engineering
title: Commissioning: Making It Work
description: A micro-lesson that makes Commissioning: Making It Work usable.

hook.text: The building is finished — but does every system actually work? Commissioning finds out.

buildup.text: Commissioning tests every mechanical, electrical, and plumbing system under real conditions.

discovery.text: HVAC systems are balanced — airflow in every room is measured and adjusted to design specs.

twist.text: Integrated systems testing runs everything together — fire alarm, sprinklers, elevators, and power.

climax.text: Without commissioning, 15-30% of energy is wasted — systems running incorrectly from day one.

punchline.text: Building it is half the job. Making it work as designed is the other half.

quiz.question: Why is building commissioning critical before occupancy?
options: It's a legal requirement to test the building's paint color accuracy
It verifies all systems work correctly together, preventing 15-30% energy waste
It tests whether the building can withstand a category 5 hurricane
